question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing goalkeeper, Bob is playing cheerleader, Claire is playing left back, Dave is playing right winger, and Eve is playing benchwarmer.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Alice and Claire trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Then, Claire and Alice trade positions. Finally, Alice and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) goalkeeper
(B) cheerleader
(C) left back
(D) right winger
(E) benchwarmer
solution:
Positions in order: Alice | Bob | Claire | Dave | Eve
Initial: goalkeeper | cheerleader | left back | right winger | benchwarmer
1. Alice–Eve: benchwarmer | cheerleader | left back | right winger | goalkeeper
2. Alice–Claire: left back | cheerleader | benchwarmer | right winger | goalkeeper
3. Claire–Alice: benchwarmer | cheerleader | left back | right winger | goalkeeper
4. Claire–Alice: left back | cheerleader | benchwarmer | right winger | goalkeeper
5. Alice–Bob: cheerleader | left back | benchwarmer | right winger | goalkeeper
Dave plays right winger, option (D).
Final answer: (D)
